title: Welcome to pg-gateway
subtitle: Let's get you set up in 5 quick steps.

providerCard.otherProvidersDesc: You can add any custom provider or pick from {{count}}+ supported providers on the providers page.

welcomeDesc: pg-gateway is a high-performance AI gateway that unifies 20+ LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API.

feature.rtkDesc: Rule-based tool-output compression to cut tokens and cost
feature.governanceDesc: Virtual keys, budgets, rate limits, RBAC

adminDesc: Protect your dashboard with an admin account. You can skip this if pg-gateway runs only on your local machine.
adminSkipHint: You can leave auth disabled if pg-gateway is only accessible from your own computer and not exposed to the network.
setupTokenCliTitle: Use the CLI to create the first admin account
setupTokenCliDesc: This instance doesn't have an admin account yet. Create one with the bundled CLI — you only need shell access to the container. After it's created, refresh this page to manage auth normally.
enableDashboardAuthDesc: When enabled, visitors must log in before they can see the dashboard or manage settings.
corsOriginsDesc: Which domains can call the API from a browser. In production, list your app's actual domain(s). Leave empty or use * for local development only.
enforceAuthOnInference: Require virtual key on every API call
enforceAuthOnInferenceDesc: When enabled, every API request must include a valid virtual key. Recommended for production.
providerDesc: Connect at least one upstream provider to start routing requests.
providerRequired: Add at least one provider to continue.
testDesc: Send a real chat request to verify end-to-end works.
testModelEmpty: No models available. Configure models on the providers page.
testVkEmpty: No virtual keys yet. Create one in Governance → Virtual Keys.
alreadySetUpNotice: Your pg-gateway is already configured. You can re-run this wizard any time.

widget.title: Setup checklist
widget.warning: Not completing these steps keeps your pg-gateway setup vulnerable.
